module: Career-related mission unlock condition types: branch level (branchLevel) and unlocked league (league). Loaded by gameplay_missions_unlocks, which calls conditionMet(self) and getLabel(self) on the condition table.
notes: branchLevel is considered fulfilled if career is not active (or if career_branches is absent).
league returns false outside career; its label is the concatenation of the league's unlock labels.

branchLevel.desc: Condition {type='branchLevel', branchId, level}: the player must have at least level `level` in branch branchId (career_branches.getBranchLevelByPath). Fields: info, editorFunction ('displayBranchLevel'), getLabel, conditionMet.

league.desc: Condition {type='league', leagueId}: the league must be unlocked (career_modules_branches_leagues.isLeagueUnlocked). Fields: info, editorFunction ('displayLeague'), getLabel, conditionMet.
